metaTitle: Custom Etched Dog Tags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom etched dog tags in bulk. Durable, permanent markings ideal for ID badges and pet tags. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Etched dog tags offer a permanent, scratch-resistant marking solution that won't fade or peel over time. Unlike printed tags, the design is cut directly into the metal surface, making them ideal for industrial safety IDs, military-style pet identification, or outdoor gear. Choose stainless steel or aluminum in various shapes and sizes, with precise etching for text, logos, or barcodes. These tags withstand harsh environments and daily wear, ensuring your brand or message stays legible for years.
heroAltText: Custom etched dog tags in stainless steel with engraved text and logo, displayed on a keyring.
